consumer: The pickup path's weight-fit check asking 'can the avatar take on this item's weight given current carried weight vs capacity?', answered by Character::can_pick_weight
scope: only the character's own carried weight plus the single candidate item (on-person carry state), not nearby/reachable inventory
decisive_source: src/character.cpp::Character::can_pick_weight — returns a bool comparing weight_carried()+weight against weight_capacity() (or weight_capacity()*4 / mass_max in the unsafe/DEBUG_STORAGE branch), i.e. the engine-computed pickup-eligibility predicate, not a re-derivation
divergence: An unsafe pickup where weight_carried()+item.weight exceeds weight_capacity() but is still within weight_capacity()*4: a naive re-derivation from raw weight_capacity() answers 'won't fit' (false), while can_pick_weight(it,false) returns true — exposing the wrong authority
